title: Quality Analysis as an In-Process Package
summary: QS-91 inventory, target split, standalone-consumer answer, repository-extraction recommendation, and verified first slice for the publishable QualityStudio.Analysis.Core package.

decision.implementedDirection: Consume Quality Studio analysis in-process through a NuGet package; keep API and UI as optional hosts.
decision.repositoryRecommendation: Keep the core project in the Quality Studio repository for now; do not extract without a later operator decision.
